warmup.description: Prepare full body for heavy compound lifting with emphasis on mobility and activation.

main_exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
main_exercises.load_guidance: Heavy load at 8-9/10 effort, leaving 1 rep in reserve
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep bar close and drive through the floor with a strong brace

main_exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
main_exercises.load_guidance: Use a heavy load that allows 1-2 reps in reserve
main_exercises.form_cue: Retract shoulder blades and lower the bar with control

main_exercises.name: Front Squat
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate-heavy load with strong core engagement
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep elbows high and torso upright throughout the movement

main_exercises.name: Pull-Ups (assisted or weighted)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Choose assistance or load that makes last reps challenging but controlled
main_exercises.form_cue: Lead with chest and avoid swinging

main_exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunges
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate load that allows consistent stride and balance
main_exercises.form_cue: Step forward with control and keep torso upright

main_exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raises
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight with controlled tempo, avoid swinging
main_exercises.form_cue: Lift knees using core, not momentum

cooldown.description: Reduce muscle tension and support recovery after high-intensity full-body work.
movements: Chest opener stretch x 30s each side
Hip flexor stretch x 30s each side

phase_notes.menstrual: This high-intensity session may feel demanding—reduce load or sets if needed and focus on controlled execution. Prioritize rest between sets.
phase_notes.follicular: Great phase to push heavy lifts like deadlifts and bench press—aim to increase load or improve rep quality. Energy and recovery are typically higher.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Peak performance phase—push intensity confidently across compound lifts while maintaining strong form. You may feel strongest and most coordinated.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Maintain strong effort but avoid pushing to failure—focus on consistent performance and controlled tempo across all lifts.
phase_notes.late_luteal: This session may feel very taxing—consider reducing volume or intensity while maintaining structure. Focus on quality movement over max effort.
